assessment_summary: The proof contains a logical error in the inductive step regarding the parity of paths and their proper 2-coloring. In step 0029, it claims that if the length of the path P is odd, the other endpoint would receive the same color as the starting point. This is mathematically false; in any proper 2-coloring of a path, an odd length (an odd number of edges) implies that the path connects vertices of different colors. The author incorrectly deduces that an odd path leads to endpoints of the same color, making this step definitively flawed.
